import assert from 'node:assert/strict';
import { spawnSync } from 'node:child_process';
import { Then, When } from '@cucumber/cucumber';

When(/I run (an unknown safeword command|safeword help)/, function (kind: string) {
  const help = kind === 'safeword help';
  const defect = process.env.BDD_CORPUS_DEFECT === '1';
  const arguments_ = defect
    ? (help ? ['definitely-not-a-command'] : ['--help'])
    : (help ? ['--help'] : ['definitely-not-a-command']);
  const execution = spawnSync(process.execPath, [process.env.BDD_CORPUS_CLI!, ...arguments_], {
    encoding: 'utf8',
    env: { PATH: process.env.PATH, SAFEWORD_NO_UPDATE_CHECK: '1' },
  });
  if (execution.error) throw execution.error;
  this.result = {
    exitCode: execution.status,
    output: `${execution.stdout}\n${execution.stderr}`,
  };
});
Then('the CLI exits nonzero and reports the unknown command', function () {
  assert.notEqual(this.result.exitCode, 0);
  assert.match(this.result.output, /definitely-not-a-command|unknown command/i);
});
Then('the CLI exits 0 and prints usage', function () {
  assert.equal(this.result.exitCode, 0);
  assert.match(this.result.output, /Usage: safeword/);
});
